questions.question: In a psalm of the sons of Korah, what did God do to the nations living in the land before their fathers?

answers.text: Drove them out with His hand
Made them friends of their fathers
Let them share the land in peace

questions.question: The sons of Korah sang that their fathers took the land by their own sword and strength. True or false?
